name: How long does a typical commercial restroom remodel take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical commercial restroom remodel take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a commercial restroom remodel varies significantly based on its scope and complexity. A small cosmetic update might take 1-2 weeks, while a complete overhaul involving demolition, plumbing re-routing, and new fixture installations could extend to 4-8 weeks or more. Factors like material lead times, inspection schedules, and the size of the restroom also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remodel times range from 1-2 weeks for minor updates to 4-8+ weeks for extensive projects, depending on complexity and scope.
